items.title: Louis Barbarin Interview, 1960-06-22
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Oh Ludwig. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. And he's done a drum around New Orleans, Iowa, with a collapsible set.

ctx.x: Your sticks are fairly heavy on the, uh, well I don't, I don't use these sticks. It's practice sticks. Oh, those practice sticks. Yeah.

Those are the S sticks they call, uh, something, one S or something, something, they have a number on them. Yeah, they, yeah. They're big heavy ones for the street. Yeah, this is naturally practice sticks, that's all. Three S, it says, yeah. Yeah, it's practice. Ludwig. That's Ludwig, yeah. Three, three S. Yeah.

I notice you hold it with your right hand about the same balance as the left, just about there. Uh, and you have all four fingers and a full finger controlling it with your right hand and the thumb too, really. You don't grip it up between your thumbs and thumbs. I'll give you, you want to get an idea about a roll? Yeah. Yeah. Let me get my pad, yeah? Yeah. Yeah.
